name: delegate-router
description: Quota-aware delegation and live supervision for Codex and Cursor agents.

native_enabled.title: Native Claude Code integration
native_enabled.description: Enable native commands and the job panel. Disabling it leaves the existing hooks, CLI and MCP broker unchanged.

usage_capture.title: Capture official Claude allowance
usage_capture.description: Read Claude Code's native subscription-window data locally. Never reads credentials or queries a usage endpoint.

compact_status.title: Show active-work status
compact_status.description: Show one compact native status line only while jobs are running, blocked or awaiting review.

reviewer_guard.title: Protect Claude reviewer headroom
reviewer_guard.description: Refuse this plugin's reviewer above the Claude avoid threshold; never changes an explicitly requested model.

attention_band.title: Show delegation attention above the prompt
attention_band.description: Show bounded input/review/failure links without opening a pane or starting a Claude turn.

inline_cards.title: Inline managed-job inspection cards
inline_cards.description: Add local job status and inspection links beneath this plugin's start-tool results; preserve the original result.

agent_capture.title: Observe native Claude agent status
agent_capture.description: Capture closed host agent lifecycle metadata. No prompts, hidden reasoning or native-agent controls. Classic hooks remain independent.

refresh_seconds.title: Local dashboard refresh interval
refresh_seconds.description: Refresh broker metadata every 3–30 seconds (values outside the range are clamped). No model or provider calls.
